focus: 131 KEEP-PASS v1 tests, how v2 runs them, E2E GP1-GP11 coverage of every B item, keyless harness

findings.claim: No GP case covers the 125 B-classified issues in the issue map; the GP1-GP11 rows in TECH-SPEC cite only 53 of them, and tickets/v2-issue-map.md has zero GP references anywhere.
findings.evidence: grep -c 'GP[0-9]' tickets/v2-issue-map.md = 0 (checked 2026-10-15). grep -o '| B ' tickets/v2-issue-map.md | wc -l = 125. This exact gap (then '53 of 124') was raised as a Major in TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md QA round-1 but does not appear anywhere in REVIEW-r4a.md (grep for 'B-row|B issues|issue map|GP refs' returns nothing) — pass A dropped it.
findings.fix: Add a GPn column to tickets/v2-issue-map.md for every B row, or a reverse table in TECH-SPEC listing which GP case replays each B issue; block the v2.0 exit gate (ADR-0003 r2) on 100% B coverage, not just GP1-GP11 passing.
findings.archaeology: N/A - this is a doc/process gap, not a v1 behavior change.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC.md:263 and :416 (Q9, marked [D] settled) still say the test runner is `node:test` only, with no mention of vitest. This contradicts ADR-0003's own r2 addendum, which reinstates a vitest-run KEEP-PASS layer as a hard exit-gate requirement ('every KEEP-PASS test passes, AND GP1-GP11 pass').
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:263 'Proposed test runner: node:test'; :416 'Q9 | Test runner = node:test ... | [D]'. docs/v2/adr/0003-e2e-only-golden-tests.md r2 section: '131 KEEP-PASS... v2 is built until every KEEP-PASS test passes'. TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md confirms KEEP-PASS files 'run on vitest+TS' (line 43, flagged Major in r2 QA, still true). REVIEW-r4a.md item 12 catches the release-skill symptom (SKILL.md never runs vitest) but not this root doc contradiction in TECH-SPEC's own settled-decision table.
findings.fix: Update TECH-SPEC Q9 to say two runners coexist (vitest+TS for the 131 KEEP-PASS files, node:test for GP1-GP11 e2e), remove the false '[D]' single-runner framing, and cross-reference ADR-0003 r2.

findings.claim: Retiring tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts (a KEEP-PASS-adjacent file covering GP9's area) without an equivalent GP9 TTY-gate case can re-break issue #534/#236 (the fix was: the stdin end listener must NOT register when stdin is a TTY). TECH-SPEC's GP9 row only checks stdin-EOF exit behavior, not the TTY gate.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md GP9 row describes lifecycle/orphan checks (stdin EOF, uncaughtException) but does not list a TTY-vs-pipe branch. This exact Major was already raised in TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md ('GP9 only checks stdin-EOF exit, not the TTY gate ... retiring that file without an equivalent GP9 case can re-break issue #534/#236'), and it still has no corresponding fix in TECH-SPEC or the v2-test-ledger row for this file as of this review.
findings.fix: Add an explicit GP9 sub-case: 'stdin is a TTY => end listener never registers, process does not exit on TTY idle', citing #534/#236; mark the v2-test-ledger row for server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts as GP9/tty-gate rather than a bare REMOVED/GP9.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: the TTY-gate behavior is pinned by tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts per TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md citing issues #534/#236. ORIGINAL_INTENT: prevent the server from treating a TTY (interactive shell, no real EOF signal) the same as a piped stdin that legitimately closes, which caused premature or missed exits. REGRESSION_RISK: high — GP9 as currently scoped in TECH-SPEC would pass even if the TTY branch were deleted, since it only exercises the EOF path. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: the new GP9 sub-case must run the built server as a real child process attached to a pty (or an equivalent isTTY stub) to actually exercise this branch, not just assert on the source file.

findings.claim: ADR-0012's keyless harness (`claude -p` on Max subscription, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/BASE_URL/CUSTOM_HEADERS) is wired into release SKILL.md step 3 as the live-test gate, but SKILL.md's own skip path ('If the owner wrote skip-live ... skip this step') has no corresponding note anywhere that skipping live tests also skips the only check that exercises the real keyless harness end to end — GP1-GP11 (e2e-style, step 2) never invoke a real agent binary.
findings.evidence: e2e/live/run.mjs is the only consumer of the keyless harness per ADR-0012; .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md step 3 is its only call site and is skippable with no gate on how many consecutive releases skip it.
findings.fix: Add a release-report field (already partly present: 'live test (passed, or skipped)') that also tracks consecutive skip count, and fail the release if skip-live is used N times in a row, so the keyless harness path does not silently rot.
findings.archaeology: N/A - new process gap, not a v1 regression.
